_comment: Feature flags for every outbound email channel and alert severity.
Single source of truth: read by features.py (Python), common_config.sh (bash),
and the 'Load feature flags' step in each workflow.
Override for one run without a commit:  KT_FEATURE_EMAILS_WEEKLY_CUSTOMER_REPORTS=true
(env var name = KT_FEATURE_ + the dotted path, upper-cased, dots -> underscores)
